lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF, an Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 25,200 shares in the offer for sale, for proceeds up to ₹3.41 crore if all offered shares are sold, with an estimated ₹7.95 crore retained.
Timing is tied to listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes this a timely point to reach out.
Gain is up to ₹2.52 crore before offer expenses and taxes; the proceeds figure is at offer price, and employee-portion shares sell at a discount so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only (promoter_holding).
